arxiv-2012-09971.title: Dots-and-Polygons
arxiv-2012-09971.creator: Jessica Dickson, Rachel Perrier
arxiv-2012-09971.description: Abstract . Dots-and-Boxes is a popular children’s game whose winning strategies have been studied by Berlekamp, Conway, Guy, and others. In this article we consider two variations, Dots-and-Triangles and Dots-and-Polygons, both of which utilize the same lattice game board structure as Dots-and-Boxes.

arxiv-2112-06830.title: DSPS: Differentiable Stellar Population Synthesis DSPS: Differentiable Stellar Population Synthesis – B
arxiv-2112-06830.creator: Andrew P. Hearin, Jonás Chaves-Montero, Alex Alarcon, Matthew R. Becker, Andrew Benson
arxiv-2112-06830.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Andrew P. Hearin, Jonás Chaves-Montero, Alex Alarcon, Matthew R. Becker, Andrew Benson. Models of stellar population synthesis (SPS) are the fundamental tool that relates the physical properties of a galaxy to its spectral energy distribution (SED). In this paper, we present DSPS: a python package for stellar population synthesis.

arxiv-2208-14527.title: Tensor current renormalization in the RI ′ scheme at four loops
arxiv-2208-14527.creator: J.A. Gracey
arxiv-2208-14527.description: Abstract Abstract. To assist the matching of lattice field theory results to the high energy continuum limit we evaluate the Green’s function where the tensor quark bilinear operator is inserted at zero momentum in a quark 2 -point function for an arbitrary covariant gauge. This is carried out in both the \overline{\mbox{MS}} and RI ′ schemes to four loops.

arxiv-2308-09494.title: Numerical analysis of the Maxwell-Cattaneo-Vernotte nonlinear model
arxiv-2308-09494.creator: A. J. A. Ramos, A. D. S. Campelo, M. M. Freitas, R. Kovács
arxiv-2308-09494.description: Abstract In the literature, one can find numerous modifications of Fourier’s law from which the first one is called Maxwell-Cattaneo-Vernotte heat equation. Although this model has been known for decades and successfully used to model low-temperature damped heat wave propagation, its nonlinear properties are rarely investigated.

arxiv-2403-18993.title: Parallel refreshed cryogenic charge-locking array with low power dissipation
arxiv-2403-18993.creator: X Bian 1, G A D Briggs 1, J A Mol 2
arxiv-2403-18993.description: Abstract To build a large scale quantum circuit comprising millions of cryogenic qubits will require an efficient way to supply large numbers of classic control signals ( Almudever et al. 2017 ; Franke et al. 2019 ; Vandersypen et al. 2017 ; Hornibrook et al. 2015 ; Reilly 2015 ) .

arxiv-2406-06696.title: Inflaton Production of Scalar Dark Matter through Fluctuations and Scattering
arxiv-2406-06696.creator: Gongjun Choi, Marcos A. G. Garcia, Wenqi Ke, Yann Mambrini, Keith A. Olive, Sarunas Verner
arxiv-2406-06696.description: Abstract We study the effects on particle production of a Planck-suppressed coupling between the inflaton and a scalar dark matter candidate, χ \chi . In the absence of this coupling the dominant source for the relic density of χ \chi is the long wavelength modes produced from the scalar field fluctuations during inflation.

arxiv-2407-13655.title: Inducing a transition between thermal and many-body localized states and detecting many-body mobility edges through dissipation
arxiv-2407-13655.creator: Yutao Hu, Chao Yang, Yucheng Wang
arxiv-2407-13655.description: Abstract The many-body mobility edge (MBME) in energy, which separates thermal states from many-body localization (MBL) states, is a critical yet controversial concept in MBL physics. Here we examine the quasiperiodic t 1 − t 2 t_{1}-t_{2} model that features a mobility edge. With the addition of nearest-neighbor interactions, we suggest the potential existence of a MBME.

arxiv-2412-11880.title: Eckstein-Ferris-Pennanen-Robinson duality revisited: paramonotonicity, total Fenchel-Rockafellar duality, and the Chambolle-Pock operator
arxiv-2412-11880.creator: Heinz H. Bauschke, Walaa M. Moursi, and Shambhavi Singh
arxiv-2412-11880.description: Abstract Finding zeros of the sum of two maximally monotone operators involving a continuous linear operator is a central problem in optimization and monotone operator theory. We revisit the duality framework proposed by Eckstein, Ferris, Pennanen, and Robinson from a quarter of a century ago.

arxiv-2509-23178.title: Limit Analysis for Symbolic Multi-step Reasoning Tasks with Information Propagation Rules Based on Transformers
arxiv-2509-23178.creator: Qin Tian 2, † \dagger , Yuhan Chen 3, † \dagger , Zhiwei Wang 1,2, † \dagger , Zhi-Qin John Xu 1,2, ∗ \ast 1 Institute of Natural Sciences, MOE-LSC, Shanghai Jiao Tong University 2 School of Mathematical Sciences, Shanghai Jiao Tong University 3 School of Mathematics and Statistics, Wuhan University
arxiv-2509-23178.description: Abstract Transformers are able to perform reasoning tasks, however the intrinsic mechanism remains widely open. In this paper we propose a set of information propagation rules based on Transformers and utilize symbolic reasoning tasks to theoretically analyze the limit reasoning steps.

The town owes its prosperity to its beautiful situation in a fine valley surrounded by mountains, and possesses a tepid mineral spring, considered efficacious in cases of general debility and for scorbutic and consumptive complaints. pmc-11494216.title: Reducing uncertainties of climate projections on solar energy resources in Brazil
pmc-11494216.creator: Francisco José Lopes de Lima, André Rodrigues Gonçalves, Rodrigo Santos Costa, Marcelo Pizzuti Pes, Ana Paula Paes dos Santos, Jose Antonio Marengo Orsini, Enio Bueno Pereira, Fernando Ramos Martins
pmc-11494216.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). The share of solar power in Brazil’s electrical grid has rapidly increased, relieving GHG emissions and diversifying energy sources for greater energy security. Besides that, solar resource is susceptible to climate change, adding uncertainty to electrical grid resilience. This study uses satellite and reanalysis data to evaluate the performance of CMIP6 models in replicating and predicting surface solar irradiance (SSR) in Brazil.

pmc-11862419.title: Ultrastructural analysis of synapses and mitochondria in the hippocampus of depressed patiens
pmc-11862419.creator: A Sebők-Tornai, D Csabai, C Szekeres-Paraczky, Z Maglóczky, M Simon, C A Stockmeier, B Czéh
pmc-11862419.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). IntroductionMajor depressive disorder (MDD) is a common multifactorial disorder, but the exact pathophysiology is still unknown. in vivo and post-mortem studies document volumetric and cellular changes in the hippocampus of depressed patients. Chemical synapses are key functional units of the central nervous system and earlier studies found reduced number of synapses in the prefrontal cortex of depressed patients (Kang HJ et al. Nature Medicine 2012;18(9):1413-1417). Mitochondria are intracellular powerhouses generating chemical energy for cellular biochemical reactions.

pmc-12469376.title: Hybrid Crude Palm Oil in Brazilian Regions: Evaluation of Knowledge, Perceptions, and Consumption Potential
pmc-12469376.creator: Agnes Sophia Braga Alves, Deborah Murowaniecki Otero, Alana Moreira Bispo, Fabiane do Espírito Santo de Jesus, Edilene Ferreira da Silva, Lívia de Matos Santos, Itaciara Larroza Nunes, Maria Cristina Teixeira Cangussu, Cláudio Vaz Di Mambro Ribeiro, Camila Duarte Ferreira Ribeiro, Witoon Prinyawiwat
pmc-12469376.description: The hybrid Elaeis oleifera × E. guineensis crude palm oil (HCPO), when compared to traditional crude palm oil (CPO), E. guineensis, presents higher levels of oleic acid, vitamin E, and carotenoids, and agronomic advantages for cultivation. This study aimed to analyze the perception, knowledge, and potential consumption of hybrid crude palm oil in different regions of Brazil.

pmc-12533462.title: Bidirectional associations among handgrip strength, gait speed, and cognitive function in older adults: a longitudinal study in rural China
pmc-12533462.creator: Qiushuo Li, Zhiyue Jiang, Hao Chen, Jin Hu, Shiqi Gui, Jing Wang, Xing Yang, Jingyuan Yang
pmc-12533462.description: BackgroundAccumulating research evidence suggests that handgrip strength (HGS) and gait speed are independently associated with cognitive function in older adults, whereas the magnitude and temporal order of the associations among HGS, gait speed, and cognitive function remain unclear.MethodsThis study adopted a cohort study design. The participants were from the Guizhou Rural Older Adults’ Health Study (HSRO).

pmc-12650073.title: Effects of Foliar Application of Paclobutrazol on Grain Yield, Aroma, and Canopy Radiation Use Efficiency of Aromatic Rice
pmc-12650073.creator: Fengqin Hu, Jian Lu, Laiyuan Zhai, Xianjin Qiu, Bin Du, Jianlong Xu, Bernard R Glick
pmc-12650073.description: Simple SummaryThe effects of paclobutrazol application on grain yield and aroma in aromatic rice remain underexplored. This study demonstrated that foliar spraying of paclobutrazol at an optimal concentration (150 mg L−1) increased canopy radiation use efficiency, thus enhancing both grain yield and 2-acetyl-1-pyrroline content. Additionally, paclobutrazol treatment improved photosynthetic performance and promoted the synthesis of key aroma precursors.

pmc-12805235.description: gomyces orientalis, and Emergomyces europaeus. While cases of Emergomycosis have also been reported in Europe, Africa, and Asia, all cases reported in North America have been caused by E canadensis, with 2 cases in the southwest region of the United States and 3 cases in Canada.

pmc-13292247.title: Inhibition of PERK signaling suppresses tumor progression and blocks GP73-GRP78-dependent stromal activation in hepatocellular carcinoma
pmc-13292247.creator: Jaafar Khaled, Maria Kopsida, Tania Payo Serafín, Sofi Sennefelt Nyman, Fredrik Rorsman, Charlotte Ebeling Barbier, Hans Lennernäs, Markus Sjöblom, Femke Heindryckx
pmc-13292247.description: Endoplasmic reticulum (ER) stress contributes to hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) progression and promotes the development of a pro-tumorigenic microenvironment. Here, we demonstrate that selective inhibition of the ER-stress sensor PERK using AMG-PERK substantially restrains tumor development when administered during early carcinogenesis in a chemically induced HCC model.

pmc-13359407.title: Does the severity of neutropenia affect mortality in bacteremic cancer patients?

pmc-13359407.description: BackgroundConcurrent bacteremia in febrile neutropenia is associated with increased mortality, but there is limited data regarding the impact of neutropenia severity on patient outcomes.MethodsA retrospective cohort study was conducted among adults (age > 18) with hematologic or solid malignancies who developed neutropenic bacteremia and received definitive cefepime treatment for > 48 h.

pmc-13380878.creator: Glorimar Santiago Rivera, Aidimar Rodriguez Fuentes, Carolina Gaud Rodriguez, Jessyca C Santiago-Morales, María J Marcos Martínez
pmc-13380878.description: Basal cell carcinoma (BCC) is the most common cutaneous malignancy and is typically characterized by slow growth, local tissue invasion, and an excellent prognosis when treated early.
